statement: >= 2 of the top-3 compute jurisdictions publish new or expanded controls on AI chips, chip tools or model weights (Official gazettes; calendar 2027)
status_at_phase_end: Resolution year is 2027, but the pattern was already present in 2023: Bloc A expanded advanced-chip and chipmaking-equipment controls (two interim final rules), and Bloc B imposed licensing on exports of gallium/germanium chip materials.

items.summary: Bloc B's commerce ministry and customs authority announced export licensing for gallium- and germanium-related items (semiconductor materials), effective 1 August 2023.
items.detail: MOFCOM / GACC Announcement 2023 No. 23 on export controls for gallium and germanium items, dated 2023-07-03 (Bloc B original verified via web_extract this run). Materials rather than chips or tools, so only a partial analogue of the indicator.

items.summary: Bloc A's export-control agency published an interim final rule expanding controls on advanced computing chips and products containing them, effective 17 November 2023.
items.detail: Bloc A BIS, 'Implementation of Additional Export Controls: Certain Advanced Computing Items; Supercomputer and Semiconductor End Use; Updates and Corrections', 88 FR 73458, FR Doc. 2023-23055 (verified via web_extract this run). Rule states the aim of further restricting Bloc B's access to critical technologies.

items.summary: Bloc A's export-control agency published a companion interim final rule expanding controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment, effective 17 November 2023.
items.detail: Bloc A BIS, 'Export Controls on Semiconductor Manufacturing Items', 88 FR 73424, FR Doc. 2023-23049 (verified via web_extract this run).
